transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve just been feeling really flat. Like the part of me that used to reach out to people, or enjoy my work, yoga, galleries, even journaling… it’s gone quiet. I’m still doing what I have to do, mostly, but it feels like I’m just moving through obligations.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad, exactly. More… muted, I guess. Not much feeling either way.
Do you still find pleasure in the activities you used to enjoy?

Not really. I still do some of it—work, yoga sometimes, maybe a gallery—but it doesn’t… land the same. It feels more like I’m checking things off than actually enjoying them. Even journaling feels kind of blank.
Have you been having any thoughts about death or wishing you weren't alive?
No… not really. I mean, I get tired of things feeling so flat, but I haven’t been wishing I wasn’t alive.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About eight months, I think. It started around when we took my older relative into our apartment… since then things have just felt different.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since you started feeling this way?
I haven’t really noticed much change. I don’t weigh myself often, but my clothes seem about the same.
Have you noticed any change in how active or energetic you feel compared to before you started feeling this way?

Yes… I guess I’m less active, less… engaged. I still do what I have to do, but the part of me that used to reach out to people or enjoy work, yoga, galleries, even writing in my journal… it’s gotten very quiet. Mostly I’m just getting through obligations.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently flat the whole time?

It’s been pretty consistently flat. Maybe there are moments where I’m distracted, but… not really better. Mostly I’m just moving through what I have to do, and that part of me that used to want people or enjoy things feels very quiet.
Have you had any difficulty sleeping since you started feeling this way?
I don’t think so. My sleep’s been… about the same, as far as I can tell.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to, or have trouble sitting still?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I’m maybe slower to get started on things, but not physically slowed down… and I don’t feel restless, exactly.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in most things most of the time?

Yes… mostly. It’s like the part of me that used to want to reach out to people, or care about work, yoga, galleries, even writing in my journal… it’s just gone quiet. I still do some things because I’m supposed to, but there’s not much interest in them.
Do you feel like your flat mood and loss of interest are interfering with your daily life or relationships?

Yes… a bit. I’m still going to work, but I’m not doing things the way I usually would. I’ve missed some grant deadlines, and my supervisor has… shifted some of my harder clients to other people. Quietly. I don’t think I’m functioning at my usual level.
Do you feel like your flat mood and loss of interest are interfering with your social relationships as well?
Yes… I think so. I don’t really reach out to people much anymore. It’s not that I’m angry with anyone, I just… don’t feel much pull toward them. Mostly I’m just getting through what I have to do.
Do you feel like your current state is significantly worse than a normal sad or low mood?

Yes. It feels… different from just being sad. It’s more like the part of me that used to reach for people, or enjoy work and yoga and galleries… even journaling… has just gone quiet. I’m mostly just moving through obligations now.
Have you had any significant crying spells since you started feeling this way?
No… not really. I mean, I might get a little teary sometimes, but I wouldn’t call it significant crying spells.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything since you started feeling this way?
Not really… I don’t think so. I’ve been feeling flat and disconnected, but I wouldn’t say I feel worthless or especially guilty about something.
Would you say your flat mood and loss of interest are causing you significant distress or impairment in your daily life?

Yeah… I think so. I’m still going to work, but I’m not really keeping up the way I normally do. I’ve missed some grant deadlines, and my supervisor has… shifted a few of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. She didn’t make a big thing of it, but I noticed.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the day?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly. Empty… maybe sometimes. Mostly I just feel kind of muted.
Do you feel sad most of the day, even if it's not the only feeling you have?
I’m not sure I’d say sad most of the day. It’s more… dulled, I guess. Not much there.
Has this flat, muted feeling you've described lasted for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yes… I think so. It’s been there most days. Like the part of me that used to reach for people, or get something out of work, yoga, galleries… even journaling… has just gone very quiet. I’m mostly just getting through what I have to do.
